textwithimage.text:
Intel Atom® E3800 (“Bay Trail-I“)

The MBox-V is an Embedded PC powered by Intel Atom E3800 (Bay Trail-I) processors, tailored to meet the unique demands of FPGA engineers. This ultra-compact system integrates seamlessly into embedded applications with its small footprint and flexible chassis design. The hardware can be effortlessly customized to suit individual requirements, including adding functionality and interfaces through internal Mini PCIe add-in cards.

Key features of the MBox-V include expandability with 2x Mini PCIe slots, high-speed I/O with 2x Gbit Ethernet and 2x USB ports, and support for dual monitors through 2x Mini DisplayPort connections. It is designed for low power consumption, making it an energy-efficient choice for various applications.

The MBox-V also offers ODM branding options, allowing customization of color, logos, and labels. With its focus on quality, durability, and long-term availability, this embedded PC caters to the needs of FPGA engineers working on embedded servers, gateway systems, automation, visualization, and monitoring solutions.

It operates with various operating systems, including Windows 7, Windows 10, and Linux, providing flexibility for different software requirements. Additionally, custom-specific software images can be pre-installed to streamline deployment for FPGA engineering projects. This Intel-powered embedded PC is a versatile and reliable choice for FPGA engineers seeking compact yet adaptable computing solutions

text.text:
Features

  • Expandability: The MBox-V features 2x Mini PCIe slots for easy expansion and customization of functionality and interfaces.
  • High-speed I/O: Equipped with 2x Gbit Ethernet and 2x USB ports, this embedded PC ensures efficient data transfer and connectivity.
  • Dual Monitor Support: With 2x Mini DisplayPort connections, the MBox-V enables the use of two high-resolution monitors for enhanced visualization and multitasking.
  • Low Power Consumption: Optimized for low power consumption (3 - 10 W), this system offers energy efficiency while maintaining performance.
  • Customizable Chassis: The MBox-V allows for individual configurations and ODM branding, with a flexible chassis design to suit various applications
